source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    occupied_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != 0 for v in row)]
    first, last = occupied_rows[0], occupied_rows[-1]
    blank_rows = [r for r in range(first + 1, last) if not any(grid[r])]
    middle = min(blank_rows, key=lambda r: (abs(2 * r - first - last), r))
    out[middle] = [3] * len(grid[middle])
    return out
'''
